parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: DuckDB :ref:`connection <howto/connection:duckdb>` to use. The default connection need not exist, in which case an in-memory database is used. Any other id must exist, and raises if it does not.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: DuckDB database to open, for example ``/tmp/analytics.duckdb``. Overrides both the connection and ``hook_params["database"]``.

parameters.name: hook_params
parameters.description: extra keyword arguments for

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: the SQL statement, list of statements, or ``.sql`` template file to run.

parameters.name: autocommit
parameters.description: (optional) if True, each command is automatically committed (default: False).

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: (optional) the parameters to render the SQL query with.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: (optional) the function that will be applied to the cursor (default: fetch_all_handler).

parameters.name: output_processor
parameters.type: Callable[[list[Any], list[Sequence[Sequence] | None]], list[Any] | tuple[list[Sequence[Sequence] | None], list]] | None
parameters.description: (optional) the function that will be applied to the result (default: default_output_processor).

parameters.name: split_statements
parameters.description: (optional) if split single SQL string into statements. By default, defers to the default value in the ``run`` method of the configured hook.

parameters.name: return_last
parameters.description: (optional) return the result of only last statement (default: True).

parameters.name: show_return_value_in_logs
parameters.description: (optional) if true operator output will be printed to the task log. Use with caution. It's not recommended to dump large datasets to the log. (default: False).

parameters.name: requires_result_fetch
parameters.description: (optional) if True, ensures that query results are fetched before completing execution. If `do_xcom_push` is True, results are fetched automatically, making this parameter redundant. (default: False).

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Optional DB schema that overrides the schema specified in the connection. Make sure that if you change the schema parameter value in the constructor of the derived Hook, such change should be done before calling the ``DBApiHook.__init__()``.

parameters.name: log_sql
parameters.description: Whether to log SQL query when it's executed. Defaults to *True*.

parameters.name: duckdb_conn_id
parameters.description: reference to a :ref:`DuckDB connection <howto/connection:duckdb>`. The default connection need not exist; when it is missing an in-memory database is used. Any other id must exist, and raises if it does not.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: database to open. Overrides the connection. ``:memory:`` (the default) opens a transient database that is discarded when the task finishes.

parameters.name: extensions
parameters.description: extensions to load on connect, for example ``["httpfs", "iceberg"]``.

parameters.name: extension_directory
parameters.description: directory DuckDB loads extensions from and installs them into. Point this at a pre-populated directory to avoid downloading extensions at task runtime.

parameters.name: autoinstall_extensions
parameters.description: whether an extension that is not installed locally may be downloaded from DuckDB's extension repository. Defaults to ``False``: a locked-down environment usually cannot reach that repository, and downloading native code at task runtime is a decision worth making explicitly. Set to ``True`` to allow it.

parameters.name: autoload_extensions
parameters.description: whether DuckDB may load an already-installed extension implicitly, so that for example querying an ``s3://`` path pulls in ``httpfs`` without it being listed in ``extensions``. Defaults to ``True``; this involves no download and no new code beyond what is already present.

parameters.name: allow_community_extensions
parameters.description: whether DuckDB may load community (third-party) extensions. Community extensions are native code from outside the DuckDB project, so this defaults to ``False``.

parameters.name: memory_limit
parameters.description: memory DuckDB may use, for example ``"2GB"``. DuckDB otherwise sizes itself from the memory it detects on the host, which over-commits inside a container that has a smaller limit than the host it runs on.

parameters.name: threads
parameters.description: number of threads DuckDB may use. Defaults to the cores DuckDB detects, which is subject to the same container caveat as ``memory_limit``.

parameters.name: temp_directory
parameters.description: directory DuckDB spills to when a query exceeds ``memory_limit``.

parameters.name: read_only
parameters.description: open the database read-only. Not valid for an in-memory database.
